# json-render core preview provenance

`json-render-core-0.21.0-3ad3818-preview3.tgz` is an Apache-2.0 preview build of
`@json-render/core` from `vercel-labs/json-render` commit
`3ad381881194e7011ad3ccd6d668033495a06c29`.

SHA-256: `3e7d2d2ac3176d5aa1afe259ca53f777a3c277fbbe867cf2c9a7e37ab97596b4`

The public npm 0.21.0 build does not export the experimental Jev composer yet.
This archive keeps the application reproducible while the API remains unreleased.
Replace it with an exact published version only after reviewing json-render's
release notes and removing the preview adapter.
